identity.title: Grand Gulf Nuclear Station, Unit 1 Licensee Event Report 2024-003-00, Feedwater Inlet Check Valve Incorrectly Determined Operable

cause.proximate_text: The direct cause of the event was degradation and wear of the valve's seat which resulted in the failed leakage rate test. An additional cause of insufficient knowledge of the Appendix J program requirements by the Senior Reactor Operators (SROs) was also identified as the cause of the incorrectly performed operability evaluation.
cause.theme: valve seat wear combined with SRO misapplication of Appendix J requirements in operability evaluation

nodes.role: system containing PCIV subject to Appendix J testing

nodes.description: Degradation and wear of check valve 1B21-F032B seat resulted in a failing leakage rate test (7650 mL/min).
Leakage rate of 7650 mL/min observed during post-work Appendix J leakage rate test, exceeding acceptable criteria.
SROs made an incorrect assumption about Appendix J requirements and concluded the failing leakage rate was within allowable limits, incorrectly determining the valve operable.
